CREATE TABLE "public"."task_logs" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration_ms" int4,
  "executed_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "execution_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "http_status" int4,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "message" text,
  "retry_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "scheduled_for" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "task_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "task_logs_duration_nonneg_2f6a87f3" CHECK (duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "task_logs_retry_count_nonneg_01b8d94b" CHECK (retry_count >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "task_logs_status_check_4bf092de" CHECK ("status" IN ('RUNNING', 'RETRYING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tasks" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cron_expression" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_execution_status" text,
  "last_run_at" timestamptz(3),
  "locked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "locked_by" character varying(100),
  "max_retry" int4 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "next_run_at" timestamptz(3),
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "retry_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(64) DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "webhook_url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_last_execution_status_check_2a50099b" CHECK ("last_execution_status" IN ('RUNNING', 'RETRYING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED')),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_max_retry_range_b33ab198" CHECK (max_retry >= 0 AND max_retry <= 10),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_name_nonempty_370c3422" CHECK (length(btrim(name)) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_payload_is_object_ce603f9d" CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_retry_count_nonneg_01b8d94b" CHECK (retry_count >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_status_check_fe77e76c" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DISABLED'))
)
